limits.body: Advisory review trail, not a sandbox. Risk flags are regex heuristics over added lines — they catch known-bad patterns, not novel ones, and can false-positive on innocent words. The browser working copy is yours alone until a maintainer seals it into the canonical log. Verify any published ledger with verify.js — never on trust.
